body: Seen in synthet-agent-flow: 'git add <paths> 2>/dev/null && git commit ...' failed on a transient index lock, the chained commit was skipped silently, and only a later tracker commit was pushed. Add a judgment-slot line: never silence git add stderr in a commit chain, and check 'git diff --cached --stat' shows the intended files before committing. Apply to the canonical skill and its compiled harness variant (user-level copy differs), then sync the mirrors.
title: commit-and-push: never silence git add errors in a commit chain
